walkthrough:
Calculate the geometry of triangle $\triangle OAM$ (with $OA = 10\text{ cm}$ and $AM = \frac{1}{2}(12) = 6\text{ cm}$):
$$OM = \sqrt{OA^2 - AM^2} = \sqrt{10^2 - 6^2} = \sqrt{64} = 8\text{ cm}$$
$$XM = OX - OM = 10 - 8 = 2\text{ cm}$$

In right-angled triangle $\triangle AXM$, find half-angle $\angle AXM$:
$$\tan(\angle AXM) = \frac{AM}{XM} = \frac{6}{2} = 3 \implies \angle AXM = \tan^{-1}(3) \approx 1.249045\text{ radians}$$

Double the angle by symmetry to find $\angle AXB$:
$$\angle AXB = 2\angle AXM = 2(1.249045) = 2.49809 \approx 2.498\text{ radians} \quad (\text{to 3 d.p.})$$

Calculate the radius $AX$ of the circular arc centred at $X$:
$$AX = \sqrt{AM^2 + XM^2} = \sqrt{6^2 + 2^2} = \sqrt{40} = 2\sqrt{10}\text{ cm} \quad (\approx 6.3246\text{ cm})$$

Calculate the circular arc length $AYB$:
$$\text{Arc } AYB = r_X\theta_X = \sqrt{40} \times 2.49809 \approx 15.7993\text{ cm}$$

Add the straight chord $AB = 12\text{ cm}$ to find the total perimeter:
$$\text{Perimeter} = AB + \text{Arc } AYB = 12 + 15.7993 = 27.7993 \approx 27.8\text{ cm} \quad (\text{to 3 s.f.})$$

Calculate the area of sector $XAYB$ (radius $\sqrt{40}$, angle $2.49809\text{ rad}$):
$$\text{Area}_{\text{sector}} = \frac{1}{2}r^2\theta = \frac{1}{2}(\sqrt{40})^2(2.49809) = 20 \times 2.49809 = 49.9618\text{ cm}^2$$

Calculate the area of triangle $\triangle AXB$:
$$\text{Area}_{\triangle} = \frac{1}{2} \times \text{base} \times \text{height} = \frac{1}{2}(12)(2) = 12\text{ cm}^2$$

Subtract the triangle area from the sector area:
$$\text{Shaded Area} = \text{Area}_{\text{sector}} - \text{Area}_{\triangle} = 49.9618 - 12 = 37.9618 \approx 38.0\text{ cm}^2 \quad (\text{to 3 s.f.})$$
